scope: Existing B03 validation predictions only; no training/inference/test access

metric_definitions.confidence: Saved predictions after confidence>=0.25/NMS; matched-only low lists because every prediction matches here. Not calibration or pre-threshold distribution.
metric_definitions.iou: Original 1280x720 continuous xyxy; matched same-class pairs only. Unmatched IoU is not invented; FN reported separately.
metric_definitions.below_counts: Strictly below threshold among matched objects; not group AP. Class images include images with that class GT/prediction.
metric_definitions.percentiles: numpy linear percentiles; object-weighted means. Group observations are correlated within one capture origin.

category_assessment.E: 용량 비교 근거없음,큰 모델 추천 보류
category_assessment.F: conf0.25/IoU0.5 부품 검출 목표에는현재60장 문제0; 엄격 위치 정밀도 합격 기준은 미정
